facts.fact: 双桅船与苏拉克威尔的游艇分头驶离丝绸之地。
facts.anchor: The schooner and Surakwel’s yacht peeled away from the Silklands in opposite directions

facts.fact: 直到伊拉瓦德的海岸线只剩远处一点微光，她才真正松下一口气。
facts.anchor: Still, she didn’t breathe easy until Irrawad’s coastline was nothing more than a distant gleam

facts.fact: 她很快在地平线上看见了高的双桅横帆船。
facts.anchor: Soon enough she spotted Gao’s brigantine on the horizon

facts.fact: 阿拉里克手下已无附魔师可用，只能靠飞得极快的贼鸥传信。
facts.anchor: But there were no Enchanters at Alaric’s disposal now, and skuas were as fast as lightning

facts.fact: 假面舞会之战与丝绸之地冲突之后，他的以太术已近枯竭，且一夜未睡。
facts.anchor: his aethermancy was on its last legs after the masquerade battle, after the Silklands skirmish

facts.fact: 船沉入海峡，塔拉辛十名拉奇斯-达洛中七人随之葬身。
facts.anchor: and seven of Talasyn’s ten Lachis-dalo, loyal and dutiful to the bitter end

facts.fact: 余下约十五艘蛾形小艇转而扑向阿拉里克与塔拉辛所乘的船。
facts.anchor: the remaining coracles, about fifteen in number, headed for Alaric and Talasyn’s own ship

facts.fact: 风暴舰“解放号”——克萨瑟夜皇的空中座舰——从厚密雪云中压了下来。
facts.anchor: The stormship Deliverance, aerial seat of the Kesathese Night Emperor, eased down from the dense stacks of snowy clouds
